title: Home Insurance Policy Schedule
key_sentences: This schedule forms part of your policy and must be read together with the policy wording and any endorsements shown below.
Please check that the information is correct and tell us within 14 days if anything needs to be changed.
Escape of water and subsidence claims under section A carry a standard excess of £500 instead of the amount shown.
You must turn off the water supply at the mains whenever the home is unoccupied for more than seven days between November and March.
If you do not tell us, your policy may not cover you fully and a claim could be refused.
